why_ai: Fiduciary trustees and member-owned boards bear the risk, and claim and rating calls are slow-feedback judgements, though eligibility and claims processing automate.
why_clarity: Contributions and claims are exact and recur monthly, but whether a rate or reserve was adequate is known years later.
why_digital: Claims, eligibility and documents are digital, but pools and funds are state-bounded, member-owned and bought through trustees and procurement.

why_ai: Credentialed consultants advise fiduciary trustees on multi-year forecasts that commit members' wages, though the projection mechanics automate.
why_clarity: The deliverable is a defined cost-per-hour projection, but it is graded only when the bargaining agreement ends.
why_digital: Claims and hours in, projections out on screen, sold through long trustee relationships.

why_ai: Adversarial liability claims and member-owned governance keep humans accountable for settlement and pricing.
why_clarity: Rates and claims are defined, but ultimate liability costs emerge years later and vary by venue.
why_digital: Claim files, video and schedules are digital, but pools serve one state's public entities through member relationships.

why_ai: Each claim is adversarial, novel and potentially eight figures, handled by licensed adjusters and defence counsel.
why_clarity: Closed value is measurable, but the early read is tacit and outcomes arrive after years of litigation.
why_digital: Complaints and video are digital, but mediation, depositions and council settlement votes happen in person.

why_ai: Allocation formulas are codified and automatable, with judgement left in loads, credits and board approval.
why_clarity: Each member's contribution follows a published formula, though adequacy shows only in later losses.
why_digital: Exposures and losses in, contributions out, computed on screen for local member boards.

why_ai: Collecting and validating schedules is data work that imagery and extraction tools largely replace.
why_clarity: A complete, valued schedule is checkable and rebuilt for hundreds of members every renewal.
why_digital: Physical assets are described through spreadsheets and imagery, and the schedule is delivered digitally to reinsurers.

why_ai: Hour-bank rules are deterministic once written down, leaving appeals and hardship cases to staff.
why_clarity: A member is eligible for next month or not, decided by rule for thousands of members every month.
why_digital: Remittances arrive partly on paper and members call the fund office, but the decision itself is digital.

why_ai: Loss control is delivered by walking sites and persuading a clerk in person, which AI cannot do.
why_clarity: Recommendations are defined, but the claims they prevent are never observed.
why_digital: Starts from physical sites, delivered in visits and letters to local members of a state pool.

why_ai: Fiduciary trustees make benefit and solvency decisions for a closed group that trusts them personally.
why_clarity: Cost per retiree is measurable, but solvency and benefit equivalence are judged over decades.
why_digital: Claims and enrolment are digital, but retirees are served by phone and mail through long relationships.

why_ai: Packet assembly and deadline tracking against a written contract are document work AI performs well.
why_clarity: Each filing is complete and on time or not, and is paid or queried within months.
why_digital: Claims and contracts in, filings out through carrier portals, entirely remote.

why_ai: Filings follow fixed templates and dates that data pipelines automate.
why_clarity: Each filing has a fixed format and deadline and is accepted or not.
why_digital: Vendor data in, electronic filings out to federal agencies.

why_ai: Repricing is rule application, though provider negotiation and balance-bill defence are adversarial.
why_clarity: Each claim reprices to a stated reference, but appeals and disputes settle the final amount later.
why_digital: Claims in, repriced claims and appeal files out, all remote.

why_ai: Underwriters carry pricing accountability on large-claim risk, though manual rating and disclosure review automate.
why_clarity: Quotes follow rating manuals, but whether a price was right shows only when the plan year runs out.
why_digital: Disclosures and quotes move digitally between TPAs, brokers and carriers.

why_ai: Trustees hire credentialed actuaries they trust for multi-year judgements that carry fiduciary weight.
why_clarity: Projections are defined but graded only years later, and each fund's advice differs.
why_digital: Data and projections are digital, but advice is delivered at trustee meetings through long relationships.

why_ai: Attorney-authored policies used in litigation carry weight, though tracking legislation and drafting updates automate.
why_clarity: Each state's policy set is defined and updated on legislative cycles, but whether a policy reduces liability shows later.
why_digital: Law and case law in, digital manuals and bulletins out, sold by subscription.

why_ai: A licensed CPA must sign the opinion and carries the liability, though testing itself automates.
why_clarity: Audits follow standards to a defined opinion each plan year.
why_digital: Records reviewed largely remotely, with some fieldwork at the fund office, sold through specialist relationships.

why_ai: Claims dashboards and benchmarks are software that AI-native tools replicate.
why_clarity: Reports are standard, though whether a flagged opportunity saved money takes a plan year to show.
why_digital: Claims files in, dashboards out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Pricing police and catastrophe exposure above pools' retentions is novel, accountable underwriting judgement.
why_clarity: Terms are defined, but excess losses arrive rarely and years later.
why_digital: Submissions and quotes are digital, placed through a few brokers and long market relationships.

why_ai: Member selection and layer pricing carry accountability and judgement on thin data.
why_clarity: Funding and dividends are defined each year, but adequacy shows when claims run out.
why_digital: Claims data and financials are digital, sold through brokers to employer members.

why_ai: Accounting and filings automate, while domicile relationships and owner trust keep a human role.
why_clarity: Captive financials and filings follow fixed formats and annual deadlines.
why_digital: Financial data in, statements and filings out to remote domiciles.

why_ai: Member-owned pools keep accountable staff for rates and coverage decisions, though analysis automates.
why_clarity: Rates and loss trends are defined annually, but rate adequacy shows only as claims develop.
why_digital: Claims and exposures are analysed on screen for members inside one state.

why_ai: Statutory enforcement authority over private plans cannot be delegated to AI.
why_clarity: Investigations follow procedures, but findings are contested and resolved slowly.
why_digital: Filings are digital, but enforcement authority is exclusive and federal.

why_ai: Eligibility, claims and contribution processing are rule execution, with member service the main human element.
why_clarity: Claims and eligibility follow plan rules at high volume with quick checks.
why_digital: Remittances partly on paper and members by phone, with processing on screen.

why_ai: Value is convening pool leaders in person and the trust of a small professional community.
why_clarity: Education and standards work has no measurable deliverable.
why_digital: Conferences and peer meetings in person, with some online education.

why_ai: Trustee education and advocacy rely on credibility with funds and legislators, though content production automates.
why_clarity: Courses and surveys are defined, but their effect on trustee decisions is not measured.
why_digital: Courses and surveys are delivered online and at in-person conferences.

why_ai: Statutory licensing and solvency authority sits with state officials.
why_clarity: Examinations follow codified procedures and filing deadlines.
why_digital: Filings are digital, under exclusive state jurisdiction.
